name: HI(NY)
introduction: HI(NY) design is a New York-based design studio founded by Hitomi Watanabe Deluca and Iku Oyamada.Specializing in branding, print design and web design for both domestic and international projects.Clients include Coca-Cola, MTV, United Nations, Victoria’s Secret, Dean&Deluca and Isetan. HI(NY) design has won numerous design awards including ONE SHOW and GDUSA.
